Internal Resources Division: The Internal Resources Division of the Ministry of Finance is the government body responsible for issuing this notification regarding customs and value added tax matters.
Ministry of Finance: The Ministry of Finance is the overarching government ministry overseeing the Internal Resources Division.
Customs: This notification pertains to the administration of customs and tax matters within the authority of the Internal Resources Division.
Value Added Tax: This notification pertains to the regulation of value added tax alongside customs matters by the Internal Resources Division.
